name: Aparthotel Andreas Hofer
beschreibung: The Aparthotel Andreas Hofer in Kufstein comprises self-contained holiday apartments. Conveniently situated near the charming historic old town and the iconic fortress, guests benefit from superb access to local amenities and dining options. Every apartment is equipped with a kitchenette, ensuring complete flexibility with self-catering. High-speed Wi-Fi and convenient on-site parking are readily available. The aparthotel is ideal for travellers seeking comfortable, independent accommodation. Scenic excursions into the surrounding mountain realm or the renowned Kaisergebirge mountains can be embarked upon with ease. Functionally furnished, these units provide the perfect home base for exploring the region.
